title: BUG: 315.2.a/315.2.b — Hold is scored before start-of-Beginning-Phase triggers resolve (unit killed by the trigger still earns the point)

repro.testName: BUG: 315.2.a/315.2.b — Hold is scored before start-of-Beginning-Phase triggers resolve (unit killed by the trigger still earns the point)

history.note: beginning phase split into beginning-step/scoring-step so Hold scores after start-of-turn triggers resolve

Splitting the beginning phase into beginning-step/scoring-step (scoring extracted to runScoringStep, run after the start-of-turn chain empties) makes the target test pass, but turns core-rules/score-denial-and-modification.test.ts red on a clean tree: 471.1.b final-point, 471.2.c conquer trigger, 194.3.a victory-score static, 485.7 first-Beginning-Phase point, 431.3 burn-out. Those point paths assume scoring happens inside beginning.onBegin. Reverted; needs the scoring/point model reworked together.
